lines.text: Secondary outcomes were 3-fold: (1) pain symptoms and
characteristics; (2) physical functioning; and (3) emotional function-
ing. Assessments of secondary outcomes were completed by the
participants at home, either electronically via the digital patient record
or on paper, within 1 week before or after the evaluation consultation.
